scope: CORRECTIONS-ONLY amendment from foundational spec audit (workflow wf_4e08b440-036). Fixes 7 clean arithmetic/text/documentation bugs that survived all prior brutalist gates because gate reviews scoped to amendments-being-made and treated items_NOT_modified as trusted. Adds CI infrastructure (locked_bounds_v1.json + test_locked_bounds.py) to prevent silent spec/code drift going forward.

trigger.finding: Audit of full spec + amendments + code found 37 issues (3 CRITICAL, 16 HIGH) in unchanged base text. CRITICAL examples: (1) Spec §4 L212/§6 L257 computed BY rank-1 raw-p threshold as q/H_N ≈ 0.013 (this is BH-style, not BY); correct formula q/(N·H_N) = 1.43e-5, which is 7× SMALLER than B=9999 raw-p floor 1e-4. (2) Spec §5 L228 Brown variance formula double-counts off-diagonal covariance.

RNG formula reconciliation. Spec §10 D10 hex-prefix form vs code little-endian-4-byte form. Reconciled to code (which produced all M2.4/M3/M2.5 results).

test_locked_bounds.py.description: CI gate. 4 tests: (1) JSON parses + has expected structure, (2) every spec_reference.search_quote is present in cited file, (3) every code_default.parameter default matches binding_value via inspect.signature, (4) |E_WASC| binding (944) matches data/wasc/E_WASC_v1.json row count. 4/4 pass at amendment time.
